note: Fenced desert RV park in Ocotillo Wells beside the Ocotillo Wells SVRA, about 20 minutes from Borrego Springs. All sites are back-in; sites 38-55 are for RVs 26 ft and under. Built around off-highway riding: a gated off-road entrance and OHV parking inside the park, with a dirt trail across Kunkler Lane to the riding area. Pool, adult spa, fenced dog run. Sells weekly, monthly and October-June season stays as well as nights. --Claude
